split_unit: complete clip and camera transform variant; dev variants 0-1; test variants 2-5
event_matching: one-to-one same class, part and zone; alert at or after onset minus 200ms; no later than onset+2000ms; checkpoint events +/-200ms
timely_matching: matched alert at or before preannotated boundary
failure_handling: all clips and expected events remain in denominator after abort; error details retained
latency_clock: source-time error-to-alert; vision processing wall-clock separately; capture-to-visible-alert NOT_MEASURED
limitations: deterministic generated tagged boards; variants share a generator; not physical capture or independent industrial validation
